in_sanskrit.name: शरववी
in_sanskrit.meaning: शरणागति (शरणागत) + वी (विजय) = शरणागतवी ≈ शरणागतिवी (शरणागति + वी) = शरदावी (शरदा + वी) = शरववी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is protected by Shara, god of the season of autumn and protector, and is victorious.

in_marathi.name: Sharhavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharhavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Sharada, the embodiment of love, beauty and grace, who is believed to bestow blessings on married life and relationships.
